_comment: Pinned to the 10.0.2xx feature band rather than to an exact patch.
The .NET SDK container images are published per feature band - 10.0.100, 10.0.200, 10.0.400 -
and there is no 10.0.203 tag to build against. Pinning the exact patch therefore builds on a
developer machine and fails inside Docker with 'A compatible .NET SDK was not found', which is
a confusing way to learn this.
latestPatch keeps the band fixed, so a build never silently moves to 10.0.4xx.
